title: Orange Tiles 1k
description: This adds 1k resolution textures of orange tiles that replaces Orange Glazed Terracotta
body:
This adds 1k resolution textures of orange tiles that replaces Orange Glazed Terracotta.
This pack also has PBR support with all your favorite shaders!
I created this pack in order to create backrooms maps for me and my friends.
Enjoy the pack!
